title: Media
subtitle: 本課限定語境：media = organizations, platforms, and channels that communicate news, information,
description: 本課限定語境：media = organizations, platforms, and channels that communicate news, information, entertainment, or public messages to large audiences · 「媒體；傳播媒介；新聞媒體」

words.note: 表示報章、記者和新聞機構整體。
words.example: The story received extensive coverage in the press.
words.exampleZh: 這則新聞受到新聞界廣泛報道。

exercises.original: The story received extensive coverage in the media.
exercises.zh: 這則新聞受到新聞界廣泛報道。
exercises.upgrade: The story received extensive coverage in the press.

options.explanation: coverage in the press 是非常自然的新聞搭配。
是傳播過程／學科，不能自然說某則新聞得到 coverage in mass communication。
只涵蓋電視／電台等廣播機構，可能漏掉報章。
是新聞工作本身，不是承載報道的新聞界。
只是形近詞，意思是壓力。

exercises.original: The media questioned the company about the incident.
exercises.zh: 新聞界就事件向公司提出質詢。
exercises.upgrade: The press questioned the company about the incident.

options.explanation: 當語境把媒體視為記者／新聞界整體時，the press 最自然。
news outlets 是機構本身；通常不直接說 outlets「質問」公司，除非作擬人化機構主語。
是一種活動／專業，不是提問者。

exercises.original: The minister spoke briefly to the media outside the building.
exercises.zh: 這名官員在大樓外短暫向新聞界發言。
exercises.upgrade: The minister spoke briefly to the press outside the building.

options.explanation: speak to the press 是非常自然的固定搭配。
不能作一群在場記者的指稱。
過於產業化，不自然作現場聽眾。
現場可能還有報章記者。
是按壓／迫切的詞形，意思不同。

words.note: 指具體發布新聞的機構、網站、電視台、電台等。
words.example: Several news outlets reported the announcement.
words.exampleZh: 多家新聞機構報道了這項公告。

exercises.original: Several media organizations reported the announcement.
exercises.zh: 多家新聞機構報道了這項公告。
exercises.upgrade: Several news outlets reported the announcement.

options.explanation: several + individual organizations 很適合可數的 news outlets。
也可概括新聞界，但不能和 several 直接形成同樣結構。
渠道不一定是新聞機構，也不會自己「report」新聞。
記者是人，不等於整個新聞機構。

exercises.original: The story was picked up by media across the country.
exercises.zh: 這則新聞被全國多家新聞機構轉載／報道。
exercises.upgrade: The story was picked up by news outlets across the country.

options.explanation: picked up by 很自然表示不同新聞機構跟進報道。
太窄，可能還有報紙和網站。
語義可理解，但不如 news outlets 精確指一間間機構。

exercises.original: Independent media reported the story differently from larger organizations.
exercises.zh: 獨立新聞機構對這則新聞的報道方式與大型機構不同。
exercises.upgrade: Independent news outlets reported the story differently from larger organizations.

options.explanation: 重點是 independent organizations，一間間媒體機構。
較像整體系統，不突出 individual organizations。
會排除電視／數碼新聞機構。

words.note: 表示透過各種媒介向大量受眾傳遞資訊的過程或領域。
words.example: She studied mass communication at university.
words.exampleZh: 她在大學修讀大眾傳播。

exercises.original: She studied media at university, focusing on how information reaches large audiences.
exercises.zh: 她在大學修讀大眾傳播，重點研究資訊如何傳達給大量受眾。
exercises.upgrade: She studied mass communication at university.

options.explanation: 大學學科＋large audiences 是典型用法。

exercises.original: Digital technology has transformed modern media and the way messages reach the public.
exercises.zh: 數碼科技改變了現代大眾傳播及訊息接觸公眾的方式。
exercises.upgrade: Digital technology has transformed modern mass communication.

options.explanation: 句子談的是「向大眾傳播訊息的整個過程」。

exercises.original: The course examines media, audience behaviour, and communication theory.
exercises.zh: 課程研究大眾傳播、受眾行為和傳播理論。
exercises.upgrade: The course examines mass communication, audience behaviour, and communication theory.

options.explanation: 和 audience behaviour / communication theory 同屬學術分析概念。

words.note: 專指報道新聞、時事和公共資訊的媒體。
words.example: The issue received widespread attention from the news media.
words.exampleZh: 這個議題受到新聞媒體廣泛關注。

exercises.original: The media gave extensive coverage to the court case.
exercises.zh: 新聞媒體廣泛報道了這宗案件。
exercises.upgrade: The news media gave extensive coverage to the court case.

options.explanation: 也可能，但包括娛樂媒體；本句明確是新聞報道。
coverage + court case 明確屬新聞。
單數只適合一個媒介，不表示整個新聞界。

exercises.original: Public trust in the media has become an important research topic.
exercises.zh: 公眾對新聞媒體的信任已成為重要研究議題。
exercises.upgrade: Public trust in the news media has become an important research topic.

options.explanation: public trust 常用於新聞機構和新聞報道的可信度研究。
是傳播過程，不是被信任的機構集合。
一般不用這種複數形式。

exercises.original: The media reported the event throughout the day.
exercises.zh: 新聞媒體整天持續報道這宗事件。
exercises.upgrade: The news media reported the event throughout the day.

options.explanation: 當重點是新聞報道整體時非常自然。
也可以，但更強調多個具體機構，而不是整體新聞界。

words.note: 表示向大量公眾傳播資訊、新聞和娛樂的傳統及大型媒介。
words.example: Television remains an important form of mass media.
words.exampleZh: 電視仍然是重要的大眾媒體形式。

exercises.original: Television has long been an important form of media.
exercises.zh: 電視長期以來一直是重要的大眾媒體形式。
exercises.upgrade: Television has long been an important form of mass media.

options.explanation: television 是面向大量公眾的大型傳播媒介。
通常主要指新聞界，不等於 television 整體。
電視可以包含新聞台，但 television 本身是媒介形式。
新聞工作不是媒介形式。
是機構／人，不是 medium 本身。

exercises.original: Traditional media such as radio, television, newspapers, and magazines still reach large audiences.
exercises.zh: 電台、電視、報章和雜誌等傳統大眾媒體仍接觸大量受眾。
exercises.upgrade: Traditional mass media such as radio, television, newspapers, and magazines still reach large audiences.

options.explanation: 四種媒介共同面向大量受眾，最精確。
television 和 magazines 也可能是娛樂內容，不一定只新聞。

exercises.original: The rise of the internet changed the structure of the media.
exercises.zh: 互聯網興起改變了大眾媒體的結構。
exercises.upgrade: The rise of the internet changed the structure of the mass media.

options.explanation: 句子談整個大規模媒體體系的結構。

words.note: 比 news outlets 稍廣，可指不同種類的媒體機構。
words.example: The campaign appeared across several media outlets.
words.exampleZh: 這項活動在多個媒體平台上出現。

exercises.original: The campaign appeared across several media platforms and organizations.
exercises.zh: 這項活動在多個媒體機構和平台上出現。
exercises.upgrade: The campaign appeared across several media outlets.

options.explanation: campaign 可能出現在娛樂／數碼媒體，不只新聞。

exercises.original: Different media reported the story in different ways.
exercises.zh: 不同媒體機構以不同方式報道這則新聞。
exercises.upgrade: Different media outlets reported the story in different ways.

options.explanation: 一間間媒體機構的報道方式不同，最自然。
渠道本身不一定製作報道。
是活動，不是一間間機構。

exercises.original: The company placed advertisements with several media.
exercises.zh: 公司在多家媒體機構投放廣告。
exercises.upgrade: The company placed advertisements with several media outlets.

options.explanation: 廣告可以投放在不同媒體機構，而不只新聞平台。
如果廣告也投放娛樂網站／雜誌，這會過窄。

words.meaning: 廣播機構；電視／電台廣播者
words.note: 表示負責透過電視、電台或其他廣播形式傳播內容的機構或人。
words.example: Major broadcasters carried the event live.
words.exampleZh: 多家主要廣播機構現場直播了活動。

exercises.original: Several media carried the event live on television and radio.
exercises.zh: 多家廣播機構透過電視和電台現場直播活動。
exercises.upgrade: Several broadcasters carried the event live on television and radio.

options.explanation: television + radio + live 是最強線索。
通常偏印刷／新聞界，不如 broadcaster 精確。
如果活動不是新聞節目，news 限定不必要。
渠道不會自行播出活動。
印刷出版物不能 live broadcast。
不是表示機構的標準名詞。

exercises.original: National media interrupted regular programming to cover the event.
exercises.zh: 全國廣播機構中斷正常節目以報道事件。
exercises.upgrade: National broadcasters interrupted regular programming to cover the event.

options.explanation: regular programming 明確指電視／電台播出機構。
抽象概念不能中斷節目。
press 不一定有 broadcast programming。
是人，不控制整個節目表。

exercises.original: The media competed for the rights to show the tournament.
exercises.zh: 多家廣播機構競逐賽事轉播權。
exercises.upgrade: The broadcasters competed for the rights to show the tournament.

options.explanation: rights to show 賽事是典型 broadcasting rights 語境。
賽事轉播不一定是新聞機構。
通常不負責影像轉播權。
不是競標權利的法律實體。

words.note: 表示用來傳遞資訊的媒介或途徑。
words.example: Organizations now use multiple communication channels to reach the public.
words.exampleZh: 機構現在使用多種傳播渠道接觸公眾。

exercises.original: Organizations use different media to communicate with the public.
exercises.zh: 機構使用不同傳播渠道與公眾溝通。
exercises.upgrade: Organizations use different communication channels to communicate with the public.

options.explanation: 語境重點是「用甚麼途徑把訊息傳出去」，不一定是正式媒體機構。
單數和搭配都不符合 different 的結構。

exercises.original: Email, websites, and social platforms are now important media for customer communication.
exercises.zh: 電郵、網站和社交平台現在都是重要的客戶溝通渠道。
exercises.upgrade: Email, websites, and social platforms are now important communication channels for customer communication.

options.explanation: email 通常不被視為 mass media。
三者都是傳遞訊息的渠道，最準確。

exercises.original: The organization expanded its media so that staff could receive updates more quickly.
exercises.zh: 機構擴展了傳播渠道，讓員工更快收到更新。
exercises.upgrade: The organization expanded its communication channels so that staff could receive updates more quickly.

options.explanation: 內部更新可以透過 email、apps、intranet 等多種渠道，不一定是 public media。
通常面向新聞與公眾，不是內部員工通訊。

falseSynonyms.zh: 新聞工作 ≠ 媒體本身 journalism 是採訪、寫作、編輯和報道新聞的專業活動。 media 是更廣的機構與傳播渠道概念。
報章 ≠ 所有媒體 newspaper 只是一種媒體。
社交媒體 ≠ 所有 media social media 是 media 的一個類別，不可在所有語境取代 general media。
廣告 ≠ 媒體 advertising 是宣傳活動／產業，可以透過 media 傳播。
溝通 ≠ 媒體 communication 是資訊交換的整體行為，範圍遠比 media 廣。
出版物 ≠ 所有媒體 publication 通常是一本／一份出版物或出版行為。
單複數與現代用法 傳統上： - medium = 單數 - media = 複數 但現代英語中 media 經常被當作集合名詞： 兩種都可見，取決於語域和地區慣例。
falseSynonyms.point: The media is reporting... The media are reporting...

falseSynonyms.zh: 形近詞陷阱 - press = 新聞界；按壓 - pressure = 壓力 兩者不能混淆。
